body.condition: For every fold \(k\), all fitted bridges and learned dictionary functions are \(\mathcal D_{A,k}\)-measurable, the calibration Gram, cross-moment, spectral projector, coefficient, and affine weights are \(\mathcal D_{A,k}\vee\mathcal D_{C,k}\)-measurable, and neither sigma-field contains observations indexed by \(\mathcal I_k\).
